title: Veil of the Ninth Moon
note: Directed automatically (film) — profile bpm 75.5, motion 0.47, world sanctum. Hand-author a sheet to overrule.

lines.text: Aiya no reya, aiya no rei
Wake, silver fire, beneath the sleeping sky
Open the gate in the heart of the night
Name me in thunder, remake me in light
Carry me over the veil of the ninth moon
Out where the lost constellations are born
Aiya, aiya, the shadows awaken
Singing the language we knew before form
If I become only breath in the starlight
Hold to the echo and I will return
Your hand was a flame on the edge of the void
A vow no machine and no god could destroy
We crossed through the temple of luminous dust
Past angels of iron surrendering rust
The future bent low like a wave at our feet
And every dead planet began its heartbeat
No crown, no kingdom, no body to bind us
Only the infinite opening wide
Aiya no reya, ancestors behind us
Aiya no reya, the unborn beside
We are the doorway, the dream, and the witness
We are the darkness remembering dawn
Carry me over the veil of the ninth moon
Out where the lost constellations are born
Aiya, aiya, the shadows awaken
Singing the language we knew before form
When I become only breath in the starlight
Follow the echo; together, return
Morning descends on the towers like water
Night folds her wings at eternity's shore
I speak your true name, and silence grows golden
The gate closes softly
We wander no more
